analysis_notes.notes:
Gap analysis of LM2/29 (Shaalah b'Bayit teaching).

1. DATASET COVERAGE: There is exactly one bechina edge in torahData.js for reference 1029: יחודים והזווגים — בטול אסור. Both nodes appear in Package 1. There are no unassigned dataset nodes.

2. SOURCE TEXT BECHINA SCAN: The source text was read in full (4 paragraphs, torah_29.txt). The teaching uses 'בְּחִינַת' explicitly in three places:

   (a) 'כִּי כָל הַיִּחוּדִים וְהַזִּוּוּגִים הֵם בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל אִסּוּר' — captured as the one bechina edge in the dataset. Core equation.

   (b) 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת: וְאָסַר לָנוּ אֶת הָאֲרוּסוֹת וְהִתִּיר לָנוּ אֶת הַנְּשׂוּאוֹת' — The Rebbe says the axiom of isur becoming heter (betrothal → marriage) IS this (i.e., IS bechina of biṭṭul isur). This does not add a new concept; the arus/nasui example IS the definition of biṭṭul isur, already captured.

   (c) 'הַיְנוּ שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה הָאִסּוּר כָּשֵׁר וְהֶתֵּר, בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל הָאִסּוּר כַּנַּ"ל' — Again the verse 'מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת' is described as bechina of biṭṭul isur. Same equation once more, not a new bechina pair.

   (d) 'כִּי הַיִּחוּד הוּא בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל הָאִסּוּר כַּנַּ"ל' — Closing restatement of the same equation.

   All four uses of 'בְּחִינַת' in the text reduce to the same single bechina pair already in the dataset. No additional bechina relationships are present.

3. CONCEPTS PRESENT IN SOURCE BUT NOT IN DATASET: Five conceptual nodes appear in the text but are not in any dataset edge:

   (a) שאלה בבית האדם — the halachic question arising about a mixture in one's home. This is the narrative frame/trigger, not a bechina equivalent of another concept. It is described as a SIGN of damage to a supernal yichud (causal reading), not as a bechina equation with another concept.

   (b) פגם ביחוד של מעלה — damage to a supernal unification. This is the cause behind the earthly halachic problem. It is related to יחודים והזווגים (Package 1) as its negative/broken counterpart, but the Rebbe never says 'פגם ביחוד IS bechina of X' — he says the question is a SIGN of (siman shel) the damage. This is a diagnostic relationship, not a bechina equation. Cannot be added as a bechina node.

   (c) ארוסה / נשואה — the betrothed woman (forbidden) and the married woman (permitted). These appear in the Torah as an illustrative example of how isur becomes heter, not as independent bechina concepts requiring their own dataset entries. They are the concrete example that proves the rule already captured in the bechina edge.

   (d) אֱלֹקִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה — the verse from Psalms 68:7, cited as proof that God arranges zivugim. The verse is exegesis, not a bechina equation between two concepts.

   (e) מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת — the second half of the same verse, interpreted as: the prisoners (assurim, forbidden) are brought out into prosperity (kasher, permitted). Used to confirm the bechina equation already captured, not a new concept node.

   None of these five concepts can be legitimately added as bechina-based additions to the package. Their relationship to the central bechina is either illustrative, diagnostic, or causal — not parallel-essence bechina.

4. EVALUATION: The dataset entry for Torah 29 (reference 1029) is complete and accurate. The single bechina edge captures the entire conceptual content of this very compact teaching. The five unlisted concepts belong to the teaching's argumentative/illustrative structure rather than its bechina network.
